name: Linear Transformer · ELU+1
tagline: Compress history into additive positive-feature states.
description: ELU+1 maps queries and keys to positive features. The model accumulates a KV state S and a normalization state z, providing a basic linear-attention control without additional gates or convolutions.
paperTitle: Transformers are RNNs: Fast Autoregressive Transformers with Linear Attention
limitations: A positive-feature control, not an exact equivalent of softmax attention. Two formal attempts failed (invalid numerics, then divergence), as did the stabilized ELU+1 without denominator; the result is reported as the separately registered ELU+1 q/k-norm variant together with these failures.
